slug: 2025-11-01 Identification System in Benin Increasing Access to Services

facts.fact: The World Bank blog says programmes such as the Alafia microcredit programme and the education system now benefit from a mobile application that authenticates fID certificates through the embedded QR code, and that SIM card providers and services can rely on the fID system to identify and authenticate individuals.

The World Bank blog names microcredit (finance) and the education system among the programmes using the QR-code authentication app for fID certificates, and lists social protection, health, education, finance and SIM providers as services the fID enables.
